name: Pi Agent Turn
description: One LLM turn, run by Pi. The BPMN token moves once per turn.

properties.label: Agent role
properties.description: Prompt variant Pi runs for this task, e.g. planner, implementer, reviewer.

properties.label: Instructions
properties.description: FEEL expression for the free-form instructions this turn receives.

properties.label: Stop reason
properties.description: Process variable the turn's stop reason is published to.

properties.label: Summary
properties.description: Process variable the turn's summary is published to.
